protocol.retrieval_query_selection: highest-purity patch within each predeclared truth region at evaluation time
protocol.retrieval_coverage: coverage-matched to 16/1024 of each realized patch grid (P@16 for 32x32 grids; P@12 for the 28x28 DINOv3 grid)
protocol.clustering: L2-normalized patch features -> per-image PCA-8 -> seeded k-means k=6 -> three spatial-majority passes
protocol.fixed_k_boundary: The originally planned k sweep was not executed; k=6 is a fixed probe, not an optimized segmentation setting.
protocol.patch_truth: Exact masks are projected to each model patch grid only after candidate construction for ARI, NMI and tolerant boundary metrics.
protocol.embedding_similarity_target: Diagnostic target is the union of the declared same_structure and texture_similar pairs; embedding_similar is the predicted cosine rule, not a semantic ground-truth relation type.
protocol.containment: unsupported by the flat candidate partition
protocol.truth_boundary: Exact controlled labels are used only after candidate construction for evaluation.
